title: Fail fast on unsupported ONNX execution provider before native initialization
description: CI regression on 2026-05-28 showed `SemanticEmbeddingPathTests.GetStatus_RejectsUnsupportedExecutionProviderBeforeOpeningOnnxSession` failing because unsupported providers reached ONNX native initialization first and returned a runtime loader exception instead of the expected validation message. Harden `OnnxTextEmbeddingProvider` so unsupported `MemorySmith:SemanticSearch:ExecutionProvider` values are rejected before any ONNX session options are created, preserving deterministic diagnostics and preventing environment-dependent failure text.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed by validating execution provider support before session creation in `MemorySmith.App/Services/SemanticEmbeddingSearchService.cs`, returning the unsupported-provider message directly when configuration is invalid. Focused validation passed with `dotnet test .\MemorySmith.Tests\MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "FullyQualifiedName~SemanticEmbeddingPathTests.GetStatus_RejectsUnsupportedExecutionProviderBeforeOpeningOnnxSession|FullyQualifiedName~CodeSearchServiceTests" --logger "console;verbosity=minimal"` (12/12).
